fields.summary: [API] Remove type assertions and establish explicit validated object contracts

content.text: Original objective: correct EnsuredAPI type assertions, make object types explicit and catch invalid inputs/state before use. Formatting prerequisite AIN-176 freshly verified Done. Work covers authored EnsuredAPI TypeScript source, migrations, tests and scripts; inventory tracks casts, const assertions, non-null assertions and explicit any separately. Shared-package model/contract corrections are included when required by API consumption; unrelated application/UI work is excluded.

Acceptance: remove type assertions and non-null assertions throughout that scope, using explicit contracts, validated unknown inputs, accurate Sequelize model/query types and control-flow narrowing. Replace literal const assertions with checked explicit declarations where needed. Do not substitute any, ts-ignore, unchecked generic cast helpers or weakened compiler settings for removed assertions. Preserve existing supported behavior, ownership, authorization, financial transactions and API responses; add regression coverage for invalid-boundary behavior discovered.

Inspect existing ORM models and raw-query projections. Use existing typed Sequelize models for appropriate persistence operations; retain necessary SQL for locking, aggregates, financial atomicity and projections with named row contracts and validation where database/JSON/provider values enter application logic. No blanket SQL-to-ORM rewrite or schema migration without a demonstrated requirement.

Work order: inventory and enforceable regression check; authentication/request/AI-model boundaries; commercial/relationships/finance/signing/marketplace; remaining ingestion/underwriting/pipeline/provider/persistence/seed boundaries; test fixtures/scripts/migrations and full verification. These are all required work, not separate alternatives. Record progress and assertion counts in TASK_HANDOFF.md; do not close after a subset.

Verification: final typecheck, ESLint, Prettier, zero-assertion scan, affected API/auth regression suites and isolated PostgreSQL integration suites for authorization and transactional flows. Extend typecheck coverage deliberately and record any existing test/migration compile gaps without suppressing them. No user-facing UI changes planned; Storybook/screenshots not applicable unless workflow behavior changes. No deployment required by this maintenance request.

Scope map: AIN-176 is completed formatting prerequisite. AIN-174/175 are completed auth regression context. Affected user-story context includes AIN-73/74/84 and AIN-138/143; their existing UI/provider/staging obligations remain separate. Broader release/CI setup and unrelated Network/Marketplace functionality are excluded because no dependency requires them. Existing finance output changes must be preserved.

The main app currently imports but does not register this wrapper, so do not describe this as a running-service outage.

Acceptance: align the documentation plugins with the existing Fastify 4 application, remove the casts and obsolete options, and verify isolated registration plus generated OpenAPI output. Preserve current production route registration; do not activate or redesign documentation UI. Run typecheck, ESLint, Prettier and a registration regression test. This is a required AIN-177 dependency, not a replacement for the overall assertion-removal scope. No UI workflow change, screenshot requirement, schema migration or deployment.
